about: Keys of Orca's en.json that no Orca code reads. tools/build.py leaves them out of the pack, and tools/audit-pack.py leaves them out of coverage. A key that a release or main reads again must leave this list before the next build.

checked.method: Orphans of main found by config/scripts/verify-localization-orphans.mjs from stablyai/orca#22056, minus every key that, or whose base without a plural suffix, appears as a string literal in the .ts/.tsx sources of the release or of main.
